public_scope: Compact audited excerpts, sources, plans, logs, provenance, analyses and verifiers. Public record bytes are derived excerpts, not untouched original JSON.
full_local_scope: All original development and confirmation records, probability payloads, released-array NPZ archives and their manifests remain in the original output directory and a complete local evidence tar.gz.
public_omission: Probability payload bytes and released-array NPZ archives are omitted from the public package. Each excerpt identifies the original full-raw SHA and records the original probability codec/shape/hash. Public input manifests preserve archive and per-array hashes and local retention locations. No images or secret release maps are present.
compression: Public evidence excerpts use deterministic gzip. The inventory records original full-raw SHA/size, excerpt SHA/size and compressed SHA/size separately. Source and non-excerpt evidence files are copied byte-identically.
public_verification: Replays excerpt labels/counts/timing sums and inventory integrity. It does not reconstruct omitted probability bytes or validate NPZ arrays that are not publicly distributed.
full_verification: The local analyzer reconstructs probability averaging and strict shared-array pairing against original records and local NPZs. Its retained audit is included publicly with that scope stated.
readiness: Final conclusions require all19 development arms to have terminal retained outcomes and all11 frozen confirmation draws per role to have retained outcomes. Draft generation must remain explicitly provisional.
size_policy: No public file above50MB; target public package gzip total below25MB. The local complete archive is not subject to repository size policy.
